'''Jeff Hansen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 5 from Billings, Mt. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115095500/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/endor.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Writing ==

The original GeoCities Corellian Engineering home page billed Hansen as "Rogue 5" for a "Neglected Cards" series of about 40 card reviews. He also wrote the follow-up "CounterStrategies: Protection from Misdirection."<ref name="geo2001">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Original GeoCities home], 13 May 2001 (Wayback)</ref>
